Subject: Request: Combined SOC2 / Pen test kickoff + DPA review

Hi Jonas,

Thanks again for the briefing yesterday — the execs liked Redwood's approach. We're trying to compress vendor onboarding and would like to run a combined session to cover: SOC 2 controls intake, a high-level pen-test kickoff, and quick DPA questions so our Legal can sign off.

Can your team do a compact, 75–90 minute walkthrough that covers each area? If so these windows work for our group (PST):
- Tue Aug 27, 15:00–16:30 PST
- Wed Aug 28, 09:00–10:30 PST
- Thu Aug 29, 18:00–19:30 PST (we have APAC folks that can join later)

I attached a short SOW and the names of the attendees. Our security team will want to kick the pen-test separately in a follow-up call if needed, but they asked to be present for a short handoff.

Can you confirm availability and the proposed agenda?

Best,
Elena
Elena Torres
Head of Cloud & Security Operations | Finline
Elena.Torres@finline.com
+1 (415) 555-0192

Subject: Re: Request: Combined SOC2 / Pen test kickoff + DPA review

Elena — thanks for the note and the SOW. We can definitely run a compact session that surfaces SOC 2 evidence touchpoints, a pen-test handoff, and DPA clarifications.

Proposed compact agenda (75 min):
- 0–10m: Intros & scope alignment (Jonas / Elena)
- 10–35m: SOC 2 controls / evidence mapping (Kimberly)
- 35–55m: Pen-test kickoff overview & scope boundaries (Marcus)
- 55–70m: DPA highlights & legal Qs (Jonas + legal brief)
- 70–75m: Actions & next steps (all)

Availability: we can take both Tue Aug 27 at 15:00 PST and Thu Aug 29 at 18:00 PST. Wed morning is tight for our APAC consultants. If you prefer the Thu evening for APAC coverage we're happy to make that work.

A couple of asks ahead of the call:
- Please share any pre-existing SOC 2 control inventory or audit reports (Drive link is fine).
- Confirm which pen-test vendor (if any) you're planning to use; we can align scope boundaries.
- Add Legal on the DPA 15-min segment if you want contract redline pointers.

I'll leave scheduling to Kimberly and Marcus to firm up the calendar invite and bridge.

Thanks,
Jonas
Jonas Weber

- Thu Aug 29, 18:00–19:00 PST (preferred)

If neither works we can fall back to Mon Sep 2.

Elena
